map.输入激光功率、焦距、切割速度与材料类型，基于线能量法估算最大切割深度、光斑直径与: Enter laser power, focal length, cutting speed and material type to estimate the maximum cutting depth, spot diameter and power density from the line-energy method.
map.切割深度随功率 P 增大、随速度 v 增大而减小；fEff 以 100mm 为峰: Cutting depth increases with power P and decreases with speed v; fEff peaks at 100 mm
map.依据激光功率、焦距、切割速度与材料类型估算切割深度；光斑随焦距增大而变大，以 1: Estimate cutting depth from laser power, focal length, cutting speed and material type; spot grows with focal length, peaking in efficiency at 100 mm (fEff = 1), decaying by 0.2 percent per mm when deviating.
map.💡 线能量 LE = 功率 ÷ 速度（J/mm）；最大切割深度 d ≈ LE ÷: Tip: line energy LE = power / speed (J/mm); maximum cutting depth d about LE / material specific cutting energy (J/mm2), corrected by focal-length efficiency. Spot diameter grows with focal length.
map.材料比切割能已含吸收率与热损失的经验修正，供估算参考: The material specific cutting energy already includes empirical correction for absorptivity and heat loss, for estimation reference only
map.焦距影响光斑大小与焦深，偏离常用值（80~150mm）会降低切割质量: Focal length affects spot size and depth of focus; deviating from the common range (80 to 150 mm) lowers cut quality
map.高反材料（铜/铝）实际吸收率受波长与表面状态影响较大: High-reflectivity materials (copper, aluminum) have absorptivity strongly affected by wavelength and surface state
map.本工具为经验估算，实际切割需结合工艺试验确定参数: This tool is an empirical estimate; actual cutting needs process trials to determine parameters
map.📚 深度解析：激光切割线能量与最大切割深度: In-depth: Laser Cutting Line Energy and Maximum Cutting Depth
map.激光工艺参数核算：按功率、焦距、切割速度估算线能量与可切最大厚度: Laser process parameter check: estimate line energy and maximum cuttable thickness from power, focal length and cutting speed
map.材料适配：不同材料单位能量需求 e 决定同参数下的切割能力: Material adaptation: different materials require different unit energy e, determining cutting ability under the same parameters
map.功率密度评估：判断适合深熔/匙孔切割还是薄板焊接: Power density assessment: judge whether deep-penetration / keyhole cutting or thin-sheet welding is suitable
map.线能量 LE=功率 P ÷ 切割速度 V（J/mm）；光斑直径 spot≈0.1: Algorithm: line energy LE = power P / cutting speed V (J/mm); spot diameter spot about 0.1 times sqrt(focal length F / 127) (mm); focal efficiency fEff = 1 minus 0.002 times absolute(F minus 100) (lower bound 0.6); maximum depth dMax = LE / material unit energy e times fEff; power density pd = P / (pi times (spot/2) squared). pd greater than 1e5 suits deep-penetration cutting, greater than 1e4 suits cutting, greater than 1e3 suits thin-sheet welding.
Example: P 1000 W, F 127 mm, V 15 mm/s, carbon steel (e = 25): LE = 66.67 J/mm, spot = 0.10 mm, fEff = 94.6 percent, dMax = 2.52 mm, pd = 127.3 kW/mm2 (greater than 1e5, suits deep-penetration cutting), suggested speed 2.1 mm/s, depth of focus about 18.87 mm.
map.焦距为什么取 100mm 附近效率最高？: Why is efficiency highest near 100 mm focal length?
map.光斑随焦距增大而变大，本公式以 100mm 为效率峰值（fEff=1），偏离则按: Spot grows with focal length; this formula peaks in efficiency at 100 mm (fEff = 1), decaying by 0.2 percent per mm away; too long a focal length gives an oversized spot, too short gives insufficient depth of focus, both need trade-offs.
map.材料单位能量 e 是什么？: What is the material unit energy e?
map.e 为熔穿单位体积材料所需能量（J/mm³），碳钢约 25、不锈钢 28、铝 4: e is the energy needed to melt through a unit volume of material (J/mm3): carbon steel about 25, stainless 28, aluminum 45, copper 60, acrylic 3, wood 2, leather 1.5; larger e gives smaller depth at the same parameters, thick plates need higher power or lower speed.
map.激光切割深度估算器基于线能量法，输入激光功率、焦距、切割速度与材料类型，估算最大: The laser cutting depth estimator, based on the line-energy method, takes laser power, focal length, cutting speed and material type to estimate the maximum cutting depth, spot diameter, power density and depth of focus, and gives a process assessment. It suits laser machining parameter pre-selection and feasibility judgment.
